title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-validation-and-improved-error-mapping-openai-compat
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: enable strict structured-output mode with robust JSON Schema validation and clearer, OpenAI-compatible error reporting. This PR implements schema validation for response_format/json_schema, surfaces deterministic error classes for downstream clients, and updates the OpenAI compatibility layer so schema validation errors map to the expected structured error envelope. Changes include runtime validation hooks, improved error messages with path/location and suggestion hints, a strict-mode enforcement path that returns specific validation errors instead of best-effort repairs, and tests/docs. Checklist: [x] runtime validation and API wiring, [x] openai-compat mapping, [x] clear error messages + unit tests, [x] docs and examples, [x] e2e test coverage for streaming + strict mode. Related: Linear ENG-4821 implements server-side strict mode; Jira SUP-3321 surfaced customer-facing error formats. See docs link: docs/api/response-format.md

merge_commit_message: Add JSONSchema strict-mode validation and map validation errors to OpenAI compatibility layer; improve error messages and add docs/tests
release_notes: Introduce response_format strict mode: server-side JSON Schema validation with deterministic error types and OpenAI-compatible error mapping. Added config RESPONSE_SCHEMA_STRICT_MODE (default=false). Improved error messages include path and hint fields. SDKs updated to expose stable error codes.
